I'm not entirely sure why these constants were added in SDL, but I think they know what they're doing, so I think it should be okay for us to add them too.
I checked the values of our constants here and SDL constants by using Visual Studio's Intellisense and they match. The order of all button names in `_joy_buttons` matches the order in the enum.
LGTM!
